description: This file defines an interface for reading capitalized income balance data related to loan accounts in the Fineract project. It declares methods to fetch capitalized income data and details for a given loan ID.

classes.name: CapitalizedIncomeBalanceReadService
classes.description: An interface defining methods to retrieve capitalized income data and details for loans.

methods.name: fetchLoanCapitalizedIncomeData
methods.description: Retrieves capitalized income data for a specific loan identified by loanId.

methods.name: fetchLoanCapitalizedIncomeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of detailed capitalized income entries for a specific loan identified by loanId.
